title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, requesting authority from the Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to Chapter 164, Section 75C for the right to exercise the power of eminent domain under Chapter 79 of the G.L. for right to take by eminent domain such rights-of-way, permanent easements, temporary easements or such other interests in land or other property necessary for the construction, operation, maintenance, alteration and/or removal of natural gas transmission pipelines, appliances, appurtenances and other equipment situated in the City of Westfield in the County of Hampden.
